long_biography.plain_text:
Pierre Beaudoin entered Bombardier through its marine-products division in 1985 after beginning his career in customer service at BIC Sport. Product-development roles in Sea-Doo and Ski-Doo led to the presidency of recreational products, where he oversaw watercraft, snowmobiles, all-terrain vehicles, utility vehicles and engine manufacturing.

Leadership in business aircraft followed before he led Bombardier as chief executive. During that transition he argued for an engineering culture measured not only by hardware but by the customer's full experience, linking technical decisions with teamwork and continuous improvement. His long involvement in business aviation was recognised in 2024 when the National Business Aviation Association honoured him and his father, Laurent, for industry leadership.
